| description = 

Misty Storyswapper says, 'Nice to meet you, Soandso. If you are a fellow bard, I must inform you that you will make no profit around here. Not with Guard McCluskey around.'

The bard is on a 6 minute re-spawn timer. She usually can be pulled safely by herself. However there is a higher level guard ([[Guard McCluskey]]) that wanders near her every hour or 2 who waits a couple minutes before pathing away. McCluskey is a corrupt guard though, so if you are kill on sight to begin with, killing Guard Gregor can bring your faction up.

In my experience killing her dozens of times, she was never once level 14. She always max hit for 28 or 32, so levels 13 or 15. Be careful, because the level 15 version is a lot tougher than the 13, and killing her 13 version can lull you into a false sense of security when trying the camp.

Additionally, always drops a {{:mandolin}} that will sell for around a platinum for quick coin.  There is a vendor behind her house you can sell to.  Evil races(even [[Iksar]]) can sell to the vendor also, but only at night when the "shift" changes and [[Silna Weaver]] is the merchant. Alternatively, you can sell to [[Carlan the Young]]. He appears to sell to anyone regardless of race/class/religion and is available 24/7, whereas Silna Weaver is only available at night. He is inside of the house where Guard Gregor spawns.
